introduction: Patch divergence recovery makes the hub-side backup ref refs/hub/replaced/<branch> usable and tidy. It adds a single-patch GET that exposes replaced_sha and an on-demand reset-to-origin endpoint and CLI command. It also adds a fixed git-server rule that rejects client pushes to the backup namespace, and removal of backup refs when a patch is removed or purged.

glossary.PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE: Workspace variable defined by spec 20 with the modes hub and origin.
glossary.backup ref: The hub-side ref refs/hub/replaced/<branch> that holds the last hub branch tip discarded when a patch branch was moved to the fork's tip.
glossary.compare-and-swap move: A git update-ref <ref> <new> <expected-old> call that fails if the ref no longer holds the expected old value; supplied by spec 20.
glossary.fork: The origin repository of a carry_patch workspace, from which the trunk was cloned.
glossary.protected namespace: Ref names beginning with refs/hub/replaced/, which the git server never lets a client create, update or delete.
glossary.recovery hook: The hook type defined in the workspace package, with a nil default, through which carrypatch supplies backup-ref reading, backup-ref removal and reset. It exists because workspace and carrypatch do not import each other.
glossary.replaced_sha: The full 40-character SHA that a backup ref resolves to, returned by GET /workspaces/:slug/patches/:id when the ref exists.
glossary.reset action: One of none, created, fast_forwarded or replaced: the outcome a reset-to-origin reports.
glossary.reset-to-origin: The operator-initiated move of a patch branch to the fork's current tip, regardless of PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY.
glossary.trunk: The hub's on-disk git repository for a workspace at <workspace_root>/<slug>/trunk.
glossary.workspace lock: The per-slug lock taken with wslock.TryLock(slug) that serialises operations on a trunk.

requirements.title: GET /workspaces/:slug/patches/:id
requirements.rationale: An operator who sees a replaced outcome needs a read endpoint that shows whether a recoverable backup tip exists.

criteria.condition: an owner, an admin or a PAT holding patches:read or patches:write sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/patches/:id for an existing patch and refs/hub/replaced/<branch> resolves to a commit in the workspace trunk
criteria.action: return the existing patch object (patchResponse, including any origin_* fields) plus replaced_sha holding the full 40-character commit SHA
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the patch object and a replaced_sha string of 40 hexadecimal characters

criteria.condition: the patch is requested and the backup ref does not exist, or the workspace trunk is not on disk, or no recovery hook is registered
criteria.action: return the patch object without a replaced_sha key
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the patch object; the JSON body contains no replaced_sha key

criteria.condition: the recovery hook returns an error while reading the backup ref
criteria.action: log the failure at warn level and return the patch object without replaced_sha
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the patch object, no replaced_sha key, and one warn-level log entry

criteria.condition: the requested patch has status deleted
criteria.action: return the patch object with its deleted status
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with status "deleted"

criteria.condition: the patch id does not exist in the workspace
criteria.action: reject the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with error message "patch not found"

criteria.condition: the caller is neither the workspace owner nor an admin
criteria.action: reject the request without revealing the workspace
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with error message "workspace not found"

criteria.condition: the caller is a PAT that holds neither patches:read nor patches:write
criteria.action: reject the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 403

criteria.action: for any other patch endpoint (list, add, update, remove, restore, sync), return a patch object without a replaced_sha key

requirements.title: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches/:id/reset-to-origin: authorization, preconditions and locking
requirements.rationale: A reset moves a branch, so it must refuse every state in which moving is wrong before it takes the lock or touches git.

criteria.condition: an authorised caller sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/patches/:id/reset-to-origin for an eligible patch and the reset completes
criteria.action: return the patch object as GET renders it (including replaced_sha when a backup exists after the reset) plus rebuild_triggered and, only when a job was enqueued, rebuild_job_id
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the patch object, rebuild_triggered (boolean) and optional rebuild_job_id (string)

criteria.condition: the caller is a PAT without patches:write, or is neither the owner nor an admin
criteria.action: reject the request before any git operation
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 for a PAT without patches:write; HTTP 404 with message "workspace not found" for a non-owner non-admin

criteria.condition: the workspace is not active or is not in carry_patch mode
criteria.action: reject the request with the same 400 messages as handleRestorePatch
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with the "workspace is not active" or "workspace is not in carry_patch mode" message

criteria.condition: the workspace clone_status is not ready
criteria.action: reject the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 409 with message "workspace clone is not ready"

criteria.condition: the patch id is unknown, or the patch branch name equals the workspace integration branch
criteria.action: reject the request in that order and never move the integration branch
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with message "patch not found" for an unknown id; HTTP 400 with message "patch branch is the integration branch" for the integration branch

criteria.condition: the patch status is merged_upstream or deleted
criteria.action: reject the request; only active, conflict and disabled patches are eligible
criteria.contract: HTTP 409 with message "patch status <status> cannot be reset"

criteria.condition: wslock.TryLock(slug) reports the workspace is busy after the preceding checks passed
criteria.action: reject the request without writing any ref; the lock is taken only after the checks succeed and is held for the whole operation
criteria.contract: HTTP 409 with error type workspace_busy and message "another operation is running on this workspace; retry later"

criteria.condition: no recovery hook is registered
criteria.action: reject the reset request
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with message "patch reset is not configured"

requirements.title: Reset semantics: fetch, compare and move
requirements.rationale: The reset must act on the fork's current tip and discard hub commits only with a backup written first.

criteria.condition: a reset holds the workspace lock
criteria.action: run the single-branch fetch +refs/heads/<branch>:refs/remotes/origin/<branch> with origin credentials (GIT_PAT, then GIT_USERNAME/GIT_PASSWORD, then none) in both PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE modes, then resolve the fork tip as refs/remotes/origin/<branch>^{commit} and the local tip as refs/heads/<branch>^{commit} (possibly absent)

criteria.condition: origin credential resolution fails or the single-branch fetch fails for a reason other than a missing branch
criteria.action: write no ref, log the underlying error text and not echo it
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with message "failed to resolve origin credentials" for a credential failure, or message "origin fetch failed" with error type origin_fetch_failed for a fetch failure; every ref is unchanged

criteria.condition: the fork does not have the branch
criteria.action: write no ref
criteria.contract: HTTP 409 with error type missing_on_origin and message "branch does not exist on origin"; every ref is unchanged

criteria.condition: the local branch is missing, or the local and fork tips are the same commit
criteria.action: when missing, create refs/heads/<branch> at the fork tip with a compare-and-swap create and report action created; when the same commit, write nothing and report action none; write no backup in either case
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with action created or none; refs/hub/replaced/<branch> is unchanged

criteria.condition: the local tip is a strict ancestor of the fork tip (GitRunner.IsAncestor on SHAs)
criteria.action: move the local branch to the fork tip, report action fast_forwarded and leave any existing backup ref untouched
criteria.contract: HTTP 200; refs/hub/replaced/<branch> keeps its previous value or stays absent

criteria.condition: the local tip and fork tip differ and the local tip is not a strict ancestor of the fork tip (diverged, or the fork tip is a strict ancestor of the local tip)
criteria.action: write the local tip to refs/hub/replaced/<branch>, overwriting any earlier backup, then move the local branch to the fork tip and report action replaced
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with action replaced; replaced_sha equals the pre-reset local tip; a repeated replaced reset overwrites the backup

criteria.action: for any branch move or creation, use the spec 20 compare-and-swap helper (update-ref <ref> <new> <expected-old>, never checkout, reset or branch -f) and hard-reset the working tree when the moved branch is the trunk's checked-out branch, so the working tree follows the branch

criteria.condition: the compare-and-swap write fails because the ref changed after the SHAs were resolved, or the write fails for any other reason
criteria.action: abort the reset, keep any backup already written, and make no further ref writes
criteria.contract: HTTP 409 with error type ref_changed and message "patch branch changed during reset; retry" for a lost race; HTTP 500 with message "failed to update patch branch <branch>" for any other failure

requirements.title: Reset: persisted sync state and rebuild trigger
requirements.rationale: A branch moved by a reset looks in_sync at the next sync, so the reset must record state and trigger the rebuild itself.

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is origin
criteria.action: after a reset completes with any action, record the patch via the spec 20 PatchStore method as origin_sync_state in_sync with origin_sha set to the fork tip and origin_synced_at set to the current time

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is hub
criteria.action: write no origin sync state

criteria.condition: the reset action is created, fast_forwarded or replaced
criteria.guard: the patch status is active or conflict and AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC is not "false"
criteria.action: enqueue a rebuild job with the same type, key slug, group slug:integration_branch, payload builder and deduplication as sync, with SubmittedBy set to the caller
criteria.contract: response rebuild_triggered true and rebuild_job_id set to the new job id

criteria.condition: AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC is "false"
criteria.action: enqueue no rebuild job after a branch move
criteria.contract: response rebuild_triggered false and no rebuild_job_id

criteria.condition: the patch status is disabled
criteria.action: move the branch but enqueue no rebuild job, because the rebuild skips disabled patches
criteria.contract: response rebuild_triggered false and no rebuild_job_id

criteria.condition: the reset action is none
criteria.action: enqueue no rebuild job
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with rebuild_triggered false

criteria.condition: the rebuild enqueue is deduplicated by the job queue
criteria.action: leave rebuild_triggered false
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with rebuild_triggered false and no rebuild_job_id

criteria.condition: the rebuild enqueue returns an error
criteria.action: log the error and complete the reset
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with rebuild_triggered false; the branch move stays in place

requirements.title: CLI: afc patch reset-to-origin
requirements.rationale: Operators drive recovery from the CLI, so the command must map directly to the endpoint.

criteria.condition: the operator runs afc patch reset-to-origin <workspace-slug> <patch-id>
criteria.action: send POST /api/v1/workspaces/<slug>/patches/<id>/reset-to-origin with no body and print the JSON result
criteria.contract: exit code 0 and the response JSON printed to standard output

criteria.condition: the number of positional arguments is not exactly two
criteria.action: reject the invocation and send no request
criteria.contract: non-zero exit code and no HTTP request made

criteria.condition: the server answers with an error status
criteria.action: propagate the error through apikit.CLIHandleError with SilenceErrors and SilenceUsage set as for patch restore
criteria.contract: non-zero exit code with the server error message reported

criteria.action: state in the reset-to-origin help text the backup ref refs/hub/replaced/<branch> and the replaced_sha field, and add no flags including no --force

requirements.title: Protect refs/hub/replaced/ in the git server
requirements.rationale: Only the hub writes backup refs; a client that could overwrite them would destroy the recovery data.

criteria.condition: a client push creates, updates or deletes a ref whose name starts with refs/hub/replaced/
criteria.action: reject that ref at the spec 22 receive-pack interception point, before the registered pre-receive hook is consulted, and keep the ref's old value
criteria.contract: client sees unpack ok and ng <ref> "refs/hub/replaced/ is maintained by the hub and cannot be pushed to"

criteria.action: for any workspace, any workspace mode, any credential with git:write and any ref name starting with refs/hub/replaced/, reject the push of that ref, whether or not a pre-receive hook is registered

criteria.condition: a single push contains a refs/hub/replaced/ ref
criteria.guard: the same push also contains a ref outside the protected namespace
criteria.action: process the other refs as usual and reject only the protected ref
criteria.contract: the normal branch is written and the protected ref keeps its old value

criteria.condition: a protected ref is rejected
criteria.action: trigger no head_sha update, no audit entry and no post-push hook for that ref
for any ref name outside refs/hub/replaced/, including other names under refs/hub/, not apply the protected-namespace rule

criteria.condition: a client runs git ls-remote or git fetch <hub_url> refs/hub/replaced/<branch>
criteria.action: advertise the backup ref and serve its commit
criteria.contract: ls-remote lists refs/hub/replaced/<branch> and the fetch succeeds with the backup commit

criteria.action: leave hub-internal writes to refs/hub/replaced/ (sync, reset, removal), which do not pass through a client push, unaffected by the rule

requirements.title: Backup cleanup on afc patch remove
requirements.rationale: A removed patch must not leave an orphan backup ref behind, and a failed cleanup must not undo a completed delete.

criteria.condition: deletePatchAndCompact succeeds in handleRemovePatch and a recovery hook is registered
criteria.action: ask the hook to delete refs/hub/replaced/<branch> (git update-ref -d), taking the branch name from the patch lookup made before deletion
criteria.contract: HTTP 204 and the backup ref no longer exists

criteria.condition: the backup ref does not exist at removal
criteria.action: treat the removal as a success
criteria.contract: HTTP 204 with no warn log

criteria.condition: the workspace trunk is not on disk at removal (for example an archived workspace)
criteria.action: treat the removal as a success and log it at info level
criteria.contract: HTTP 204 and one info-level log entry

criteria.condition: the hook fails to remove the ref for any other reason
criteria.action: log a warn entry with slug, branch and error and not change the response, because the row is already gone
criteria.contract: HTTP 204

criteria.condition: the workspace lock is held by a running sync
criteria.action: remove the patch without taking the workspace lock
criteria.contract: HTTP 204, never 409

criteria.condition: no recovery hook is registered
criteria.action: remove no ref and remove the patch as before
criteria.contract: HTTP 204

criteria.condition: a patch is soft-deleted by a rebuild and later restored with POST .../restore
criteria.action: leave refs/hub/replaced/<branch> untouched by the soft deletion so the restored patch keeps its backup
criteria.contract: the backup ref has the same value before the soft deletion and after the restore

requirements.title: Backup cleanup on purge of soft-deleted patches
requirements.rationale: Purging rows without their refs would orphan the backups, and nothing else would find them.

criteria.action: provide a method that lists soft-deleted rows older than a cutoff with id, workspace slug and branch name, implemented by SQLPatchStore and by every test double

criteria.condition: the ref-aware purge routine runs
criteria.action: for each expired soft-deleted row, remove refs/hub/replaced/<branch> in that workspace's trunk (using the workspace root and the carry-patch git runner factory) and then delete the row by id only while status='deleted', using a 7-day retention
criteria.contract: returns the number of rows purged

criteria.condition: removing the backup ref of an expired row fails
criteria.action: keep that row for the next purge, log a warn entry and continue with the remaining rows
criteria.contract: the row still exists with status deleted and is not counted in the return value

criteria.condition: the backup ref is missing or the workspace trunk is not on disk for an expired row
criteria.action: treat the ref removal as a success and delete the row
criteria.contract: the row is deleted and counted

criteria.condition: a soft-deleted row is within the retention window
criteria.action: leave the row and its backup ref untouched
keep the PurgeDeletedPatches signature and behaviour and keep the two-argument PurgeExpiredDeletedPatches(ctx, store) working without ref cleanup, with the ref-aware routine as a new function

criteria.condition: listing the expired rows fails
criteria.action: return the error and delete no row and no ref
criteria.contract: non-nil error returned and zero rows purged

criteria.action: add no scheduler and no call to any purge routine in cmd/af-hub/main.go

requirements.title: Package boundaries, hook wiring and documentation
requirements.rationale: The workspace and carrypatch packages cannot import each other, and the steering requires documentation to change in the same session.

criteria.action: define a recovery hook type in a new file next to branch_check_hook.go, with a registration function and a nil default, carrying three operations: read the replaced SHA for a slug and branch, remove the backup ref for a slug and branch, and run a reset for a slug, a patch and the caller's auth info returning the action, SHAs and rebuild outcome

criteria.condition: the reset operation returns a classified error (workspace busy, branch missing on origin, origin fetch failure, credential failure, ref changed, or other failure)
criteria.action: map it to the status code, error type and message defined for that case in 23-REQ-2 and 23-REQ-3
criteria.contract: 409 workspace_busy, 409 missing_on_origin, 502 origin_fetch_failed, 502 "failed to resolve origin credentials", 409 ref_changed, 500 "failed to update patch branch <branch>" respectively

criteria.action: implement the recovery hook with the git runner factory, the workspace root, store.GetVariableValue, the origin credential resolver, an injectable single-branch fetch function, the job queue, the spec 20 PatchStore methods and the PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE parser, registered by cmd/af-hub/main.go next to the existing hooks, with no import between workspace and carrypatch in either direction
authenticate the new routes only through requirePatchReadScope, requirePatchWriteScope, lookupPatchWorkspace and apikit.GetAuthInfo, with no local auth structs and no custom context keys

describe the new GET and reset-to-origin endpoints, the recovery command git fetch <hub_url> refs/hub/replaced/<branch>, the removal cleanup, the push rejection message and the hub.patch.reset event in docs/api.md, docs/openapi.yaml, docs/cli.md, docs/permissions.md, docs/architecture.md (if its hook list names the others) and two rows of the patch-endpoint table in docs/carry_patch_workflow.md, and leave docs/configuration.md unchanged

requirements.title: Audit events and logging
requirements.rationale: Operators must be able to find every reset and every discarded commit in the audit log.

criteria.condition: a reset completes successfully
criteria.action: emit one hub.patch.reset event (constant added to internal/audit/types.go next to EventRebuildFollowup) with resource_type patch, the workspace slug, the caller as actor and metadata {branch_name, action, local_sha, origin_sha, replaced_sha}, where action is none, created, fast_forwarded or replaced
criteria.contract: one hub.patch.reset audit entry per successful reset

criteria.action: for any hub.patch.reset event, omit local_sha when there was no local branch and include replaced_sha only when the action is replaced

criteria.condition: a reset has action replaced
criteria.action: also emit hub.patch.replace with branch_name, replaced_sha, origin_sha and trigger set to reset_to_origin
criteria.contract: a hub.patch.replace audit entry whose metadata trigger equals reset_to_origin

criteria.action: emit hub.patch.replace events with no trigger key, which consumers read as sync

criteria.condition: a reset fails with any error
criteria.action: emit no audit event
criteria.contract: zero hub.patch.reset and zero hub.patch.replace events recorded

criteria.condition: the audit emitter is nil or returns an error
criteria.action: skip emission when nil, or log the error when it fails, without affecting the outcome
criteria.contract: the HTTP status and body are the same as with a working emitter

criteria.condition: a replacement (replaced reset) or a backup-ref removal occurs
criteria.action: log it at info level with slug, branch and the SHAs involved

execution_paths.title: Operator resets a diverged patch to the fork tip and the rebuild follows

steps.action: runs afc patch reset-to-origin <slug> <patch-id> after a diverged report
sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/<slug>/patches/<id>/reset-to-origin with no body
checks scope, ownership, workspace state, clone status and patch eligibility, then calls the recovery hook
takes the workspace lock and fetches +refs/heads/<branch>:refs/remotes/origin/<branch> from the fork
finds the tips diverged, writes the local tip to refs/hub/replaced/<branch> and moves refs/heads/<branch> to the fork tip with a compare-and-swap update-ref
records in_sync origin state in origin mode and enqueues a rebuild job submitted by the caller
emits hub.patch.reset and hub.patch.replace (trigger reset_to_origin) and returns 200 with the patch object, replaced_sha, rebuild_triggered and rebuild_job_id

execution_paths.title: Operator recovers a discarded tip from the backup ref

steps.action: sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/<slug>/patches/<id> for a patch whose branch was replaced
reads refs/hub/replaced/<branch> through the recovery hook and returns the patch object with the 40-character replaced_sha
runs git fetch <hub_url> refs/hub/replaced/<branch>
advertises and serves the backup ref through git-upload-pack and the operator receives the discarded commit

execution_paths.title: A client push to the backup namespace is rejected while other refs are accepted

steps.action: pushes refs/hub/replaced/<branch> together with a normal branch to the hub git server
evaluates the fixed protected-namespace rule at the receive-pack interception point before the pre-receive hook
writes the normal branch, rejects the protected ref with ng <ref> refs/hub/replaced/ is maintained by the hub and cannot be pushed to, and keeps the old backup value
receives unpack ok with one ng line and one accepted ref

execution_paths.title: Removing a patch removes its backup ref

steps.action: runs afc patch remove for a patch that has a backup ref
looks up the patch row, deletes it with deletePatchAndCompact and emits hub.patch.delete
runs git update-ref -d refs/hub/replaced/<branch> in the workspace trunk without taking the workspace lock
returns 204 and the backup ref no longer exists

execution_paths.title: Purging expired soft-deleted patches removes their backup refs

steps.action: invokes the ref-aware purge routine with the store, workspace root and git runner factory
lists soft-deleted rows older than 7 days with id, slug and branch
removes refs/hub/replaced/<branch> in each workspace trunk, treating a missing ref or trunk as success
deletes each row by id while status is deleted, keeps rows whose ref removal failed, and returns the purged count

execution_paths.title: A reset that cannot reach the fork writes nothing

steps.action: sends POST .../patches/<id>/reset-to-origin while the fork is unreachable
takes the workspace lock, runs the single-branch fetch and receives a failure
logs the error text, returns 502 origin fetch failed with error type origin_fetch_failed, and emits no audit event
releases the workspace lock with every ref unchanged
